title: Yellowed Crunchy Canadian Rye Bread Toast
description: A charred and crunchy Canadian dish featuring rye bread and render-fat, perfect for a solo dinner, this flexitarian-friendly recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the rye bread into 1-inch thick slices and place on a baking sheet.
Drizzle the render-fat over the bread slices, making sure each slice is coated.
Sprinkle the salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika evenly over the bread slices.
Place the baking sheet in the oven and bake for 10 minutes.
Remove the baking sheet from the oven and broil the bread slices for 2 minutes, or until they are charred and crunchy.
Remove the bread slices from the oven and let cool for 1 minute.
Serve the yellowed crunchy Canadian rye bread toast hot and enjoy.
